# Billing Integrity Checklist: Billing — Google Play

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of linking, verification, webhook security, state mapping, privacy and API contract completeness before tasks and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard release gate. Audience: PR reviewer. Focus (from the request): linking, verification, webhook security, state mapping, privacy, API contract.

## Linking

- [ ] CHK001 Is "linked to exactly one account, ever" stated together with the mechanism that enforces it (a unique key, not only a check)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Is every combination of purchase link state × obfuscated reference × caller given a single outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007–FR-010, Research R-3]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "active account" defined consistently, including pending-deletion and purged accounts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the outcome for an upgrade/downgrade token whose replaced token belongs to another account specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified what is recorded (and whether a subscription is created) when an old token in a non-granting state (expired, revoked) is verified? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the behaviour for two accounts verifying the same unreferenced token concurrently defined? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Verification and acknowledgement

- [ ] CHK007 Is "paid" defined per product kind (subscription states, one-time purchase state) rather than left implicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-020, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the ordering of commit and acknowledgement specified, with the failure case on each side? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the acknowledgement retry schedule consistent with the 3-day refund window and SC-002's 1-hour target? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the statuses for Google unavailable, token unknown, product mismatch and pending each mapped to exactly one answer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016, §5]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the "client never acknowledges" rule part of the frozen contract, not only prose? [Traceability, Spec §5, contracts/google-play-api.md]

## Webhook security

- [ ] CHK012 Are all five baseline checks (signature, issuer, audience, issued-at window, replay) present with exact accepted values? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030–FR-032]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the source of verification keys restricted to Google's endpoint, with the unknown-key-id refresh bounded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the answer for a verified push whose payload cannot be decoded specified, distinct from an unverified one? [Gap, Spec §FR-033, Plan A-6]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "nothing written before verification" stated for every refusal path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the response to unreachable key material consistent with the baseline ("rejected, left for the provider to retry")? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, Security baseline]

## State mapping

- [ ] CHK017 Does every Google state map to a local status using only ADR-0013's drawn arcs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020–FR-025, Research R-5]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the number of `SubscriptionLapsed` events for the zero-length grace hop specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the rule for period ends moving backwards (late or skewed data) stated? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK020 Is it specified that `billing.grace_days` never applies to `google_play`, including the 72-hour fallback? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the audit vocabulary extension (`purchase`, `renew`, `recover`) traced to the code that owns the audit detail type? [Dependency, Spec §FR-051]

## Privacy

- [ ] CHK022 Are all secrets (token, reference, order id, key, assertion, access token, push bearer) listed as never logged, returned, queued, evented or audited? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK023 Is retention specified for every new record, including after the account purge? [Completeness, Spec §FR-038, §FR-039, §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the operator-visible fields enumerated, with what is never shown? [Clarity, Spec §FR-052, §FR-053]

## API contract completeness

- [ ] CHK025 Does every operation list every status it can return, including idempotency, budget, version gate and 503? [Completeness, Spec §5, google-play.yaml]
- [ ] CHK026 Are request bounds (token length, product id length, restore item count, duplicate tokens) stated with their field error codes? [Clarity, Spec §5]
- [ ] CHK027 Are the two new error codes defined with status, retry class and meaning, and is their catalogue landing scheduled? [Traceability, Spec §5, contracts]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the webhook's exemption from the client-version gate stated? [Gap, Spec §5, google-play.yaml]
- [ ] CHK029 Do the restore outcomes and the verify errors agree (each verify error has a restore outcome)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017]

## Dependencies and assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 Is the no-new-dependency constraint stated with the swap path to the official library? [Assumption, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the owner's setup prerequisites (Play Console, service account, Pub/Sub push) listed as non-blocking open questions? [Dependency, Spec §9]

## Notes

- Items left unchecked for the reviewer. Gaps found while generating this list (CHK005, CHK014, CHK021, CHK028) were fixed in the spec and plan in the same pass; the reviewer confirms.
